missionSprintFindings.vacuousTypecheck: The documented stage-1 gate (`tsc --noEmit`) compiles ZERO files and had been reporting PASS unconditionally for every prior sprint — the root tsconfig.json is references-only. Found when hardening-gate stage [1/8] said PASS while stage [4/8] `npm run build` (tsc -b) failed on src/game/missions/MissionMarkers.tsx TS6133 (unused import). Both gate scripts + CLAUDE.md + CONVENTIONS.md now use `tsc -b --force`; the corrected stage was verified to FAIL on a deliberately injected type error before being trusted. Same failure family as the historical `playwright | tail` truncation bug. Note: noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters live only in tsconfig.app.json, so unused-symbol errors are invisible to both the vacuous form and oxlint.
missionSprintFindings.useFrameThrowFreeze: MissionMarkers read streamingRuntime.sectors (real field: .states) and threw every frame once a mission went active — which froze the ENTIRE R3F loop, so unrelated systems (interaction prompts, teleports) appeared broken. Diagnosed only via page.on('pageerror'). Recorded as CONVENTIONS gotcha 13.
missionSprintFindings.anchorPlacement: Two mission anchors were authored at plausible-looking but wrong coordinates — the courier depot inside the Nook Offices building, the fixer garage 2m from a live traffic lane. Both were invisible to tests and caught only by screenshots. Anchors must be visually verified.
missionSprintFindings.soakIterationLimit: The 180s mission soak completes only ~1 courier + ~2 hot-cargo attempts because 6h/20h in-game cooldowns do not clear in 3 real minutes and setTime() moves the hour, not the day. The soak proves its invariants but is not a high-iteration fuzzer. A day-skip test API would be needed for that.
missionSprintFindings.sectorWedgeBug: REAL PRODUCT BUG found by missions E2E test 12 (~1 run in 8, surfaced as a gate E2E failure). A sector could wedge in `loading` FOREVER after an unload→reload — no colliders, a hole in the world, and silently blocked teleports into it (teleportCoordinator only commits once the destination reports ready). Two independent defects: (1) React identity for sector roots was `key={id}` with effect deps `[id]`, so an unload→reload could coalesce into 'no membership change' — the roots never remounted, the readiness effect never re-ran, and nobody reported readiness for the new generation (signature: lifecycle=loading, visualsReady=false, staleCompletions=0, queue=1). Fixed with getMountedSectorEntries() + key=`${id}:${generation}` + generation passed as a prop. (2) reportSectorVisuals/Colliders guarded staleness only on ready===true, so a passive (async) useEffect cleanup from generation N could clear generation N+1's live flags. Fixed by guarding both directions. Both pinned by unit tests in sectorStreaming.test.ts (each verified to FAIL against the old code). Test 12 then passed 16/16 in isolation vs ~1-in-8 before. NOTE: this was pre-existing, not a mission regression — missions merely provided the first test that force-cycled a sector while ambient routed-vehicle prewarm concurrently demanded it.
missionSprintFindings.missionTestUnderBudget: Mission E2E test 12 used fixed 900ms sleeps around a forced sector unload/reload. Measured reality: unload 0.9-7.3s (it must wait out an in-flight prewarm load plus the 3s unloadDelayMs) and remount→ready 1.5-4.9s. Besides tipping over 15s under full-suite load, an early-expiring sleep would let a slow unload silently SKIP the cycle the test exists to prove (a false pass). Rewritten to wait on the real sector lifecycle (matching the established tests/e2e/sectors.spec.ts pattern), with 20s budgets ~4x the measured worst case.

repoHardeningFixes.summary: Six targeted repo-hardening fixes after the mission sprint. Unit 729→744, E2E 157→159 (missions.spec 14→16).
repoHardeningFixes.fix1_portableGate: scripts/hardening-gate.sh + crime-gate.sh had hardcoded `/Users/harshitkargeti/GTABrowser` and a Claude scratchpad log path. Now: repo root resolved from the script location (SCRIPT_DIR/..), logs via `mktemp -d` with `trap ... EXIT` cleanup, Node pin applied only when the nvm dir exists (else falls back to PATH node for CI). Verified by running the FULL gate from a different path (/private/tmp/blocklife-altpath, node_modules symlinked).
repoHardeningFixes.fix2_exactVehicleIdentity: drive_vehicle_to_zone (MissionDirector) and deliver_vehicle (engine) only checked isPlayerCarStolen()/the interactable — NOT that the delivered car was the exact assigned target. A player could boost the target, then boost a replacement and deliver the decoy. Fix: vehicleCrimeState records the player car's `sourceVehicleId` (getPlayerCarSourceId); the Director gates drive_vehicle_to_zone on source===targetVehicle, and the engine gates deliver_vehicle via ctx.drivenVehicleSourceId===target. Identity cleared on handoff/terminal (bridge) and on arrest/incap/reset/load (resetVehicleCrimeRuntime). Unit + E2E (missions.spec:15) prove a replacement cannot complete Hot Cargo.
repoHardeningFixes.fix3_vehicleLost: The `target_vehicle_lost` failure rule was declared but unreachable (failureReasonFor never produced it). Implemented a typed `vehicle_lost` event with deterministic detection: boosting a DIFFERENT vehicle while driving the mission target emits vehicle_lost(target) (store.stealVehicle → bridge.notifyVehicleStolen), which failureReasonFor maps to target_vehicle_lost (only for the mission's own target). Unit + E2E.
repoHardeningFixes.fix4_persistenceHardening: serializeMissions now persists `receipts` and `attemptSeq`; applyMissionSave restores them, keeps attemptSeq monotonic across sessions (max of saved/receipt-derived/active), and RE-MINTS a restored active mission's attemptId so a reloaded pre-completion save is a distinct attempt — a reward can't be duplicated and attempt ids can't repeat. Rigorous nested validation (history/cooldowns/receipts/active objectiveStates+variables+ownedEntityIds). Old saves (no receipts/attemptSeq) remain valid. Unit tests prove no double-pay and no id reuse; E2E (missions.spec:16) round-trips save/load.
repoHardeningFixes.fix5_ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml (push + PR): Node from .nvmrc (23.3.0), npm ci, tsc -b --force, lint, unit, production build, and a dist test-API leak check. Browser/visual suites intentionally excluded from CI; README documents the full local `scripts/hardening-gate.sh`.
